title: Synthetic Persona Pretraining: Alignment from Token Zero
abstract: arXiv:2608.13482v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As language-model-based AI is increasingly deployed in autonomous settings, aligning its goals and values with those of humans becomes critical. Today, alignment, and the assistant identity itself, are typically introduced only after pretraining, once behavioral priors are already established. This can make values a thin overlay, rather than deeply rooted, and facilitate subsequent misalignment. Pursuing a different paradigm, we introduce Synthetic Persona Pretraining (SPP), which installs the desired assistant persona from token zero in pretraining. First, we annotate pretraining documents with value-aligned first-person reflections derived from a normative value constitution. Second, we pretrain via the standard cross-entropy loss on standard pretraining documents as well as their reflections, which installs the desired persona among a multitude of other personas. translated_title: 合成人格预训练：从零标记开始的对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13482v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：随着基于语言模型的AI在自主环境中的部署日益增多，使其目标与价值观与人类对齐变得至关重要。目前，对齐以及助手的身份特征通常在预训练之后才引入，此时行为先验已经建立。这可能导致价值观仅作为浅层覆盖，而非根深蒂固，并可能促进后续的错位。为探索不同范式，我们引入了合成人格预训练（SPP），该方法在预训练的零标记阶段即安装期望的助手人格。首先，我们用源自规范性价值宪章的、价值对齐的第一人称反思来注释预训练文档。其次，我们使用标准交叉熵损失在标准预训练文档及其反思上进行预训练，这会在众多其他人格中安装期望的人格。最后，我们在用户-助手对话数据上进行后训练，这绑定并强化了该人格。
tldr: 该论文提出合成人格预训练（SPP），通过在预训练初期即注入价值对齐的助手人格，实现从零标记开始的对齐，确保价值观根深蒂固而非浅层附加。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Synthetic Persona Pretraining (SPP), which installs a value-aligned assistant persona from token zero during pretraining, ensuring deeply rooted alignment rather than a superficial overlay.
